events.verdict: Harris (BKN) grasps and then quickly releases Duren's (DET) jersey as they each move into the lane to establish rebounding position.
Burks (DET) and Durant (BKN) each make clean contact with the ball prior to any incidental contact occurring during rebounding.
O'Neale (BKN) engages and disengages with Bogdanovic (DET) during the inbound.
Durant (BKN) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Simmons (BKN) moves forward slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring at the end of Bogdanovic's (DET) drive.
Simmons (BKN) brings his left hand down and makes marginal contact with Bogdanovic's (DET) right arm while defending the drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Durant (BKN) makes clean contact with the ball and bats it away prior to incidental arm contact occurring with Stewart (DET) during rebounding.
Duren (DET) moves forward slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with O'Neale (BKN) as O'Neale retrieves the loose ball.
Hayes (DET) brings his right arm toward Irving's (BKN) path and marginal contact occurs with Irving's front prior to when Irving changes direction at the top of the perimeter.
Hayes (DET) initiates contact with Irving's (BKN) right forearm prior to the release of his jump shot attempt, which is subsequently affected.
Bogdanovic (DET) moves toward Claxton (BKN) and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during rebounding.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Irving (BKN) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Claxton (BKN) and Bogdanovic (DET) engage and disengage with one another along the perimeter.
Claxton (BKN) moves forward slightly prior to incidental foot-to-foot contact occurring with Bogdanovic (DET) after Bogdanovic receives the pass.
Simmons (BKN) engages and disengages with Duren (DET) during rebounding.
The timeout awarded to BKN is recognized prior to a potential traveling violation by Simmons (BKN).
Hayes (DET) commits a take foul on Irving (BKN).
Bogdanovic (DET) maintains a rested left forearm on Durant's (BKN) side and marginal contact occurs as Durant makes the pass.
Irving (BKN) brings his off-arm toward Hayes' (DET) side and marginal contact occurs as Hayes' momentum continues to carry him forward inside the perimeter.
Stewart (DET) raises his right leg into the air and marginal lower body contact occurs with Irving (BKN) as Irving goes around the screen.

Replay review of the foul called on Hayes (DET) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Hayes closes out the jump shot attempt and initiates contact with Irving's (BKN) right leg, causing Irving to become dislodged. The game clock was re-set to 0:29.3.
Duren (DET) is firming up over his left foot and absorbs the contact made with O'Neale (BKN) as the screen is set.
Irving (BKN) engages and disengages with Bogdanovic (DET) off-ball.
Irving (BKN) legally contests Bogdanovic's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Duren (DET) and O'Neale (BKN) engage and disengage with one another after the release of the jump shot attempt.
Durant (BKN) brings his left hand forward slightly prior to marginal contact occurring with Burks' (DET) front as he accelerates on the wing.
Burks (DET) commits a take foul on Durant (BKN).
Simmons (BKN) and Stewart (DET) engage and disengage with one another as the free throw attempt is released.
Duren (DET) establishes himself in O'Neale's (BKN) path and does not deliver illegal contact as the defensive switch simultaneously occurs.
Claxton (BKN) gets to ball height and cleanly blocks Bogdanovic's (DET) jump shot attempt.
Stewart (DET) brings his right forearm toward Durant's (BKN) side and marginal contact occurs as Durant retrieves the rebound.
